newsitem.title: USA: Ferrofluidics sees year revenues consistent.
newsitem.headline: Ferrofluidics sees year revenues consistent.

text.p: Ferrofluidics Corp said on Tuesday it expects full-year fiscal 1997 revenues to be consistent with those from the previous year, even as it boosts spending on developing new products and markets.
Revenues for the first half of fiscal 1997, through December 31, were $33.0 million, with earnings per share of $0.13, compared with $33.9 million and $0.29 for the same period the year before.

The company said its spending on developing new products and markets was up $640,000, or $0.10 per share, in the first six months of 1997 compared with the same period a year ago. For full-year 1997, the company expects such spending to be up $0.20 per share from 1996.
